description: FITINI_COV finaliteration exact covariance ingredients before matrix inversion. MW covariance is outer product of frozen_MWXT_FLUXERR; diagonal data variance is DATAFLUX_ERR squared plus FUDGEFLUX_ERR squared. Model covariance is remainder after subtracting these from supplied frozen covariance. All variables preserve actual source precision; these common-block inputs are generallyfloat32 except COVMAG_ERR.
